parameters.name: ArchitectureType
parameters.description:
The architecture type. Valid values:
* **cluster**: cluster.
* **standard**: standard.
* **rwsplit**: read/write splitting.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
* **PrePaid**: subscription.
* **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: EditionType
parameters.description:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:
* **Community**: ApsaraDB for Redis Community Edition.
* **Enterprise**: Tair Enhanced Edition.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The Redis-compatible engine version of the instance. Valid values: **2.8**, **4.0**, **5.0**, **6.0**, and **7.0**.

parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description:
The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

* **true**: expired.
* **false**: not expired.

parameters.name: GlobalInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter child instances of distributed instances from the returned instance list. Valid values:
* **true**: returns only child instance information.
* **false**: does not return child instance information.

parameters.name: InstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types](~~107984~~).

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the instances to query.
> To specify multiple instance IDs, separate them with commas (,). A maximum of 30 instance IDs can be specified in a single request.

parameters.name: InstanceStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the instance. Valid values:
* **Normal**: normal.
* **Creating**: being created.
* **Changing**: being changed.
* **Inactive**: disabled.
* **Flushing**: being flushed.
* **Released**: released.
* **Transforming**: being transformed.
* **Migrating**: being migrated.
* **BackupRecovering**: being restored from a backup.
* **MinorVersionUpgrading**: minor version being upgraded.
* **NetworkModifying**: network type being changed.
* **SSLModifying**: SSL being changed.
* **MajorVersionUpgrading**: major version being upgraded. The instance can be accessed normally.

> For more information about instance statuses, see [Instance statuses and impacts](~~200740~~).

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The category of the instance. Valid values:
* **Tair**: Tair (Enhanced Edition)
* **Redis**: ApsaraDB for Redis Community Edition
* **Memcache**

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
* **CLASSIC**: classic network.
* **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:
* **MASTER_SLAVE**: high availability (dual-replica)
* **STAND_ALONE**: single replica
* **double**: dual-replica
* **single**: single replica
> For cloud-native instances, select **MASTER_SLAVE** or **STAND_ALONE**. For classic instances, select **double** or **single**.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the instance list. Pages start from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: PrivateIp
parameters.description: The private IP address of the VPC.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

> When calling this API, if the **Tag** parameter is specified, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.
> You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) API or use the console to obtain the list of resource group IDs. For more information, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

parameters.name: SearchKey
parameters.description: The keyword used for fuzzy search by instance name or instance ID.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the instance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag. The tag key and value together form a key-value pair.
> A maximum of 5 tag key-value pairs can be specified at a time.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. The tag value and key together form a key-value pair.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.
